configuration.text: To show the footer button, set buttonLabel: the default button is hidden when it is omitted or empty.
With the default header, set institutionName: omitted or empty, the header has no bank name, as there is no placeholder (headerSlot replaces the header instead).
items gives one row per entry, a label and a value; omit it, or pass an empty list, for no rows. There is no placeholder copy.
buttonDisabled disables the default footer button; it is ignored when footer is provided.
disableTruncation lets the header name, the badge, the row values and the default footer button wrap instead of ending in an ellipsis.
The card's own defaults are Button / Size S, AppearanceBrand Secondary and Emphasis Medium; modes you pass are merged on top, and the same modes reach the badge, the button and the slots.
Button / Size S, the card's default, makes a 32 px button; M makes it 42 px and XS 24 px.

examples.purpose: A linked savings account with four facts, the number masked, a green Active status Badge, and View statement as its one action; named for screen readers by the account.
examples.jsx:
<CardBankAccount
  institutionName="Jio Payments Bank"
  institutionAvatar={require('../assets/jio-gold-logo.png')}
  badge={<Badge label="Active" modes={{ 'Semantic Intent': 'System', AppearanceSystem: 'positive' }} />}
  items={[
    { label: 'Account type', value: 'Savings' },
    { label: 'Account number', value: '•••• 4521' },
    { label: 'IFSC', value: 'JIOP0000001' },
    { label: 'Last updated', value: 'Today, 9:14 AM' },
  ]}
  buttonLabel="View statement"
  onButtonPress={() => {}}
  accessibilityLabel="Jio Payments Bank savings account ending 4521"
/>

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Defaults to institutionName. Declared: Accessibility label for the card region.

props.name: institutionName
props.description: Institution name shown in the header next to the avatar. Omit it, or pass an empty string, and the header has no placeholder bank name. Pass `headerSlot` to replace the header entirely. Default "", from the component source.

props.name: institutionAvatar
props.description: Avatar source for the institution. Forwarded to the underlying `InstitutionBadge`. Accepts any {@link UnifiedSource}.

props.name: badge
props.description: A word becomes a Badge with the card's modes; a Badge you pass is given the card's modes with its own on top, so a status Badge keeps its green while the button stays purple. Declared: Header badge. Pass a string to render the default `Badge` with that label, or a custom `ReactNode` for full control. Pass `false`/`null` to hide the badge entirely.

props.name: headerSlot
props.description: Override the entire header. When provided, replaces the default `InstitutionBadge` + `Badge` row.

props.name: items
props.description: Data rows shown in the middle. Each entry renders a left-aligned label and a right-aligned value. Omit the prop, or pass an empty list, for no rows. There is no placeholder copy.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom content slot rendered between the header and the footer. Overrides `items` when provided.

props.name: buttonLabel
props.description: Footer button label. The default button is hidden when this is omitted or empty, so an untouched card does not say "Button". Ignored when `footer` is provided.

props.name: onButtonPress
props.description: Footer button press handler. Ignored when `footer` is provided.

props.name: buttonDisabled
props.description: Disables the default footer button. Ignored when `footer` is provided.

props.name: footer
props.description: Override the footer. Pass a `ReactNode` for full control or `false`/`null` to hide it entirely.

props.name: modes
props.description: The card's defaults (Button / Size S, AppearanceBrand Secondary, Emphasis Medium) sit under the modes you pass, and the same modes go to the badge, the button and the slots; the card itself doesn't read the theme provider. Declared: Design token modes for theming (e.g. `{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }`). Defaults to `{ 'Button / Size': 'S', AppearanceBrand: 'Secondary', Emphasis: 'Medium' }` so the footer button matches the Figma reference out of the box. Caller-supplied modes are merged on top and can override any of the default keys.

props.name: disableTruncation
props.description: When `true`, disables text truncation: the trailing ellipsis (`…`) is never shown and any `numberOfLines` clamp is ignored, so the text wraps to as many lines as it needs even when horizontal space is tight. Reaches the header name, the badge, row values, and the default footer button.

props.name: CardBankAccountItem.label
props.description: Left-aligned label text (e.g. "Account type"). A field of each items row.

props.name: CardBankAccountItem.value
props.description: Right-aligned value. Strings render through the `text/*` design tokens. Pass any `ReactNode` to fully customise the value (e.g. obfuscated account numbers, masked dots, icons). A field of each items row.

props.name: ...CardBankAccountBaseProps
props.description: Inherited React Native props the component also accepts. They are not part of the design contract and no guide documents them.

modes.name: AppearanceBrand
modes.description: With Emphasis, colours the footer button and a word badge. At Medium: Secondary (the card's default) light purple, Primary light gold, Neutral a dark grey button and a light grey badge, Tertiary a blue button and a light blue badge. Declared: A token collection CardBankAccount reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

slots.name: badge
slots.description: Header badge. Pass a string to render the default `Badge` with that label, or a custom `ReactNode` for full control. Pass `false`/`null` to hide the badge entirely.

slots.name: headerSlot

slots.name: items
slots.description: A structured slot: an array of CardBankAccountItem rows. Data rows shown in the middle. Each entry renders a left-aligned label and a right-aligned value. Omit the prop, or pass an empty list, for no rows. There is no placeholder copy.

gaps.text: Figma's badge is amber, a colour the package tokens don't have; the package's word badge takes the button's colours, light purple by default (#344).
Rows are 17 px tall in code against Figma's 16, so at 292 px wide the card is 207 px tall against Figma's 204.
